payload.message:
Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

Objective: run the WF78/WF85 pre-open owner-review proof bridge after daily-core freshness and before open-ready deployment/radar alerts. This is review-only packaging/proposal proof.

Execute exactly this single command:
python scripts\wf78_open_ready_owner_review_cron_runner.py --write --validate

Do not run additional commands. Do not inspect files manually. The runner writes/refreshed proof surfaces including:
- tmp\wf78-open-ready-owner-review-cron-runner.json
- tmp\wf78-position-sizing-surface-review.json
- tmp\wf78-deployment-readiness-review.json
- tmp\wf78-source-artifact-capture-review.json
- tmp\wf78-position-sizing-integration-proposal.json

Response contract: reply exactly NO_REPLY when the command exits 0 and validation is ok. If blocked, report only runner status, failing artifact, and next repair owner.

Boundaries: review-only owner-readiness/deployment-readiness proof. No deployment surface mutation, no ticker-card/canon/portfolio/SQL-canon mutation, no cash/sizing/sleeve/risk-rule apply, no capital deployment approval, no paper/live order, no brokerage/account action, no money movement, no customer/public output, no config/auth/channel/runtime mutation, and no owner approval inference.
